Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Saulot takes control of Nergal by using a superior Spirit Marionette
(Nergal has 1 blood left and a Perfectionist).

Then Saulot's controller has Nergal take a bleed action modified by a
Day Operation and a basic Daring the Dawn.

Does Nergal burn because the damage from basic Daring the Dawn is done
after the resolution of the action but still during the action? (as per
the link below), and he does not survive long enough to get the blood
from Perfectionist (which happens "after the action is resolved")?

http://groups.google.es/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/93bb7e28f80f95c3

Name: Perfectionist
[Gehenna:C]
Cardtype: Master
Master: archetype.
Put this card on a vampire you control. Once per turn, when this
vampire sucessfully performs an action and no reaction cards are
played, he or she gains 1 blood after the action is resolved. A vampire
can have only one archetype.
Artist: Ken Meyer, Jr.

Or do both the damage from Daring the Dawn and the blood gain from
Perfectionist happen in the same window, and you (Nergal's temporary
controller) can order the effects of these two cards?

--
